title: 第二十七章  红蓝胭脂
content_zh:
“切，我以为是什么宝贝呢，不就是胭脂。”墨攻行大失所望。

    “你懂个屁，俗人。”玉京子不屑道。

    玉京子好像看到什么稀世珍宝一样，左看右看一副爱不释手的样子。然后用手指轻沾一点，在另外手背上，轻轻地旋开。

    淡红色的胭脂顺这手指的转动，慢慢地化开，与皮肤浑然天成，看不出一点妆容的痕迹。

    玉京子的皮肤本身就粉嫩白皙，敷过胭脂的那点，更是凝脂如玉，吹之欲破。

    “果然是红蓝花，只有红蓝花才有如此神效。”玉京子激动地说道。

    “哼哼。”芊芊将手掌一翻，表示要将胭脂收回。

    “姑娘。”玉京子刚准备说话，就被芊芊打断。

    “嗯。”芊芊将手掌摇了摇。

    玉京子恋恋不舍地将胭脂盒盖好，还了回去。

    “姑娘，能不能将卖给我，只要你开个价。”

    “要不，一半也行。”玉京子一副可怜兮兮的样子。

    看到玉京子的样子，墨攻行十分好奇，什么样的胭脂可以让，一个诸侯这么低声下气。

    “这是什么天地灵宝？”

    “闭嘴，俗人。”玉京子鄙视道，然后给墨攻行上了一课。

    这盒胭脂的主要成分是红蓝花，这种花非但不稀有，相反还到很多，一到正月就会漫天遍野都是。可关键是可是红黄花只能生长在龙城周边。

    龙城是西荒诸族共同的圣地，每年正月，西荒诸族就放下彼此仇怨，各族领袖都会来到龙城祭天。

    红蓝花的花期，正好就是这段时间，等各族祭完天，红蓝花也都枯萎，无法制成胭脂。

    红蓝花为圣地之物，在西荒是严禁私自采摘。

    这就意味着，要采摘红蓝花，就要冒着被西荒诸族发现的危险。没有人会为了一个除了妆容，没有其他作用的红蓝花，去冒这样的险。

    在九州红蓝花一直都是有市无价，平时很难看到有红蓝花流出。

    现有的一点红蓝花，也几乎都是当年夏人西征所带回。可在悠长的历史中，仅仅只有三次，大军跨过西荒，直接攻进龙城，将正在祭天的各部俘虏。并将漫天遍野的红蓝花都采摘一空。最近的一次，已经过去将近千年。

    芊芊手中的那盒胭脂，可想而知是多么珍贵。

    “这。这，我看你每天都在用。”墨攻行被芊芊的奢侈所震撼。

    墨非夜却觉得，一盒毫无作用的胭脂能有如此价值，真的应了“朱门酒肉臭路有冻死骨”。不过他也无能为力，这些问题不是他一个墨者，或者墨家能够改变。

    “也没他说得这么玄乎，当年带回了不少，我家正好种活了一点，这次逃出来就顺手抓了一盒。”

    “姑娘，既然你家里有，那能不能把这盒卖给我。”玉京子与芊芊商量。
content_en:
"Tsk, what kind of treasure did I think it was? It wasn't Rouge." Mo Gongxing was disappointed.

    "You know nothing, common man." Yu Jingzi said disdainfully.

    Yu Jingzi seemed to have seen some rare treasure, looking left and right as if she couldn't put it down. Then use your fingers to lightly apply a little bit on the back of your other hand, and gently unscrew it.

    The light red rouge slowly melted along with the movement of the fingers, blending perfectly with the skin, with no trace of makeup visible.

    Yu Jingzi's skin itself is pink and white, and the spots where she has applied rouge are as creamy as jade, and are about to break apart.

    "It is indeed a red and blue flower. Only red and blue flowers can have such magical effects." Yu Jingzi said excitedly.

    "Hmph." Qianqian turned her palm over to show that she wanted to take Yanzhi back.

    "Girl." Yu Jingzi was about to speak when she was interrupted by Qianqian.

    "Yeah." Qianqian shook her palm.

    Yu Jingzi reluctantly closed the rouge box and returned it.

    "Girl, can you sell it to me, as long as you set a price."

    "Otherwise, half is fine." Yu Jingzi looked pitiful.

    Seeing Yu Jingzi's appearance, Mo Gongxing was very curious, what kind of rouge could make a prince be so humble.

    "What kind of heaven and earth spiritual treasure is this?"

    "Shut up, you vulgar." Yu Jingzi said contemptuously, and then taught Mo Gongxing a lesson.

    The main component of this box of rouge is red and blue flowers. Not only are these flowers not rare, but they are abundant. Once the first lunar month comes, they will be everywhere. But the key point is that red and yellow flowers can only grow around Dragon City.

    Dragon City is the common holy land of all the tribes in the Western Wilderness. Every year in the first month of the year, all the tribes in the Western Wilderness put aside their hatred towards each other, and leaders of each tribe come to Dragon City to offer sacrifices to heaven.

    The flowering period of red and blue flowers happens to be during this period. After all the tribes have finished their sacrifices to heaven, the red and blue flowers will wither and cannot be made into rouge.

    Red and blue flowers are sacred to the Holy Land, and it is strictly forbidden to pick them without permission in the Western Wilderness.

    This means that if you want to pick red and blue flowers, you have to risk being discovered by the tribes of the Western Wilderness. No one would take such a risk for a red and blue flower that has no other function except makeup.

    Red and blue flowers have always been available and priceless in Kyushu. It is rare to see red and blue flowers flowing out.

    Almost all the existing red and blue flowers were brought back by the Xia people during their Western Expedition. But in the long history, there were only three times when the army crossed the Western Wilderness, directly attacked Dragon City, and captured various tribesmen who were worshiping heaven. And picked all the red and blue flowers all over the sky. The most recent time has been nearly a thousand years.

    The box of rouge in Qianqian's hand can be imagined how precious it is.

    "This. This, I see you use it every day." Mo Gongxing was shocked by Qianqian's luxury.

    Mo Feiye, however, felt that a box of useless rouge could be of such value, which really meant that "the bones of a wealthy family would freeze to death on the road to wine and meat." But there was nothing he could do. These problems were not something he, a Mohist, or the Mohists could change.

    "It's not as mysterious as what he said. I brought back a lot of it back then. My family just happened to be doing a little bit of farming. I grabbed a box when I escaped this time."

    "Girl, since you have it at home, can you sell me this box?" Yu Jingzi discussed with Qianqian.
